senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; אפל)slow to ripen, late in the season.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 6a">M. Kat. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳</he> late produces, opp. <cite ref="B00789"><he>בַּכִּיר</he></cite>.
Gen. R. s. 61, beg. זרע בא׳ sow at the advanced season. Fem. אֲפִילָה advanced autumn, rainy season.
Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ bot.—Pl. אֲפִילוֹת. Y. R. Hash. III, beg. 47ᵇ sheeps which conceive late in the season.—קרן אפיל, v. אָפֵל II.
